text:
Situation: Remifentanil hydrochloride has been on FDA shortage status since 2022-06-28 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a span of 52 months. Affected manufacturers per FDA include Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., and Mylan Institutional. Our inventory at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside carries NDC 00143939210 labeled by Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. That NDC maps to label set 9d289052, which names Hospira, Inc. and Navinta LLC as registered manufacturing plants.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2022-06-28. FDA issued an OAI classification letter to Hospira, Inc. on 2020-04-22 (797 days before the shortage posting) and to Navinta LLC on 2018-04-20 (1,530 days before the shortage posting). FDA’s shortage record does not state that these OAI actions caused or explain the shortage.

Our position: Corvale General holds 130.67 units (16.6 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units (6.8 days on hand). A rule-based transfer of 16 units from General to Lakeside would bring both sites to at least two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Approve transfer of 16 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.

Not recommended: No additional purchasing or allocation changes at this time.
